answer: Stop sybils with a lotus bloom, a pulse challenge, and a zenith cap. Each identity must grow one lotus, a bloom that opens only after a full epoch of honest work and wilts if lent to another identity. Each epoch a pulse challenge is issued, salted per address and open only inside one beacon window, so no precomputed answer works twice. Influence is capped at a zenith set by the min-cut of the applicant's social graph. If N identities share one funder, their cuts overlap and each pays the full cut, so N clones pay roughly N squared for one share while one honest agent pays one cut.
